id: title:TueHaulund:download temporal test servers with retries before tests use them

review.posthog_relevance: Reduction of CI startup time and flaky test failures by caching and retrying Temporal server binaries, without changing production behavior.

P1.F1.H1 adds a conditional import to avoid unnecessary dependency loading, and P1.F2.H1 implements a cached, retried, and throttled download of Temporal binaries.
